# Bid the waste and the tear-out, not the room count.

> Price a flooring install from waste, tear-out, and stairs — not a flat dollar per square foot. See purchased material, kitchen tile demo hours, tread labor, and the walk-away price.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
